summary: Defines the Incident Object Description Exchange Format (IODEF), a data format that incident response teams use to share information about computer security incidents. It gives an information model and an XML Schema data model. It was replaced by RFC 7970.

eli5.summary: Security teams need a common form to fill in when they report a break-in to each other. IODEF is that form, so everybody understands the report. It was replaced by RFC 7970.

questions: how do csirts share incident data
